# Devtimize
> A product engineering studio building web apps, mobile apps,
> desktop software, AI chatbots, trading bots, and automation tools.
> Founded in 2024 by Shoaib Liaqat and Hamza Amin — two CS graduates
> from Pakistan serving clients in the United States, United Kingdom,
> Canada, Europe, Australia, and Kuwait.

## AI Receptionist (https://www.devtimize.com/ai-receptionist)
24/7 AI phone answering and appointment booking for local businesses (HVAC, dentists, lawyers, medspas, roofing, plumbers, restaurants, real estate). Available for businesses in the US, UK, Canada, Europe, Australia, and Kuwait. Setup within 48 hours.
Pricing: systems typically range from $1,000-3,000 setup and $250-1,200/month depending on scope (call volume, number of locations, integrations). No fixed public tiers — book a call for an exact quote.

## Key Projects Delivered
- Trading Bot (Backtest + Live): Python algorithmic trading with real-time execution
- Chatbot & RAG Assistant: LangChain-based Q&A system with custom knowledge base
- Event Push App: Flutter mobile app with OneSignal push notifications
- Emotion Detector: Desktop app with CNN-based facial emotion recognition
- Vendor Shipment Portal: ASP.NET MVC web portal for logistics management
- Inventory & Billing System: WPF + SQLite desktop software
- Restaurant Website: Full-featured restaurant web presence
- E-Commerce Website: MERN-based online store with payments
